notes.title: The purpose of the player
notes.notes:
(Sorry in advance for my bad English)

Hi!

First, I want to say thanks. I managed to sell the 100th copy in October (I’m about at 113 copies now). I could never imagine that I would make it so far and this is mostly thanks to you all, who have bought and shared Harmony of the bravest to your friend and social medias. It really means a lot to me but there’s something else you could do.

The purpose of the player to indie developers like me, who would like to be “someone” in this big pond full of sharks, is your reviews. Because if you review my game, more and more people will try it. To date I only received two formal reviews here on Steam, which moreover are not visible because they’re written by beta players that received the game for free. 

I really would like to hear what you think of Harmony of the bravest, since that’s the only way I can improve: and the only one who can do that is you! I accept constructive criticism, so don’t be shy and feel free to tell me what’s good and what’s bad of my game.

Thank you,
LSGames

notes.title: Update and future plans
notes.notes:
There's a new update!
Thanks to Olivia's plugin (https://fallenangelolivia.itch.io/), now encounters have been considerably reduced and escaping from battles is assured. 

I don't think there will be more updates since I think the game is complete now and I'm already working on the document of my next game, which won't see light before a lot of years I suppose.
Thank you for your support and for buying Harmony of the bravest!
See you later!

notes.title: About a Mac OS version
notes.notes: Hello! I received some questions about a Mac OS version. The fact is: Apple doesn't allow to deploy things for Mac on other OS. So, as long as I only use windows, I won't be able to deploy a Mac OS version. I hope to reach soon a sum to buy a second-hand apple computer so that MacOS users can play Harmony of the bravest too! See you soon!

notes.title: About summer sales and a notice
notes.notes: Hi! As you could see, Harmony of the bravest is not joining Steam summer sales: this is not due to a choice but to the shop's rules: but don't worry, I'm planning some discounts already! In addition, I apologize for my absence these days but I'm dealing with a small surgery, I hope to come back soon! See you later!

notes.title: About the frequent updates
notes.notes: Hello! You could have notice a lot of updates. Well, I'm trying to correct the game as long as people notice me bugs. There was one game-breaking bug near the end of the game that I have just corrected. Thank you for buying Harmony of the bravest and have fun!
